title: Tiếng Gọi Từ Biển Khuya
hook_3s: Giua bien dong, co tieng goi ten Hai tu duoi nuoc vong len.
message: Ton trong bien ca va biet on ca Ong; nguoi di bien song duoc nho long biet on va giup do lan nhau.

location.name: Lang chai ven bien mien Trung, lang Ong
location.region: Ven bien mien Trung, Viet Nam
location.note: Lang Ong: noi tho ca Ong (ca voi) cua ngu dan; truoc khi ra khoi, ghe thuong ghe lang khan ca Ong phu ho.

character_sheet.hai: Hai, 22 tuoi, ngu dan tre lan dau ra khoi xa cung cha; toc den ngan, ao thun trang, quan den, chan dat tren boong; nhanh nhen, can dam.
character_sheet.cha: Cha cua Hai, 55 tuoi, da sam nang, ria xam, ao ba ba den, khan ran; tay lai vung, it noi.
character_sheet.ca_ong: Ca Ong (ca voi) khung lo, lung xam xanh, hien lanh; chi hien lung va vay, khong phai ma quy, khong lo mat.

visual_dna.palette: xanh bien dem lanh, xam song, den long vang am lam diem nhan; bao hoa thap
visual_dna.lighting: dem bien dong, chop xa, den dau va den long vang am
visual_dna.camera: doi goc lien tuc: toan / trung / can; chuyen dong cham, tinh lang

negative_prompt: no red Chinese lanterns, no Chinese curved temple roofs, no Chinese-style temples, no text, no logo, no watermark, no blood, no gore, no visible ghost face, no charms or talismans

scenes.label: Tieng goi tu duoi nuoc
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, wide shot of a wooden fishing boat in a rough dark sea at night, big waves, storm clouds, distant lightning, cold blue palette, film grain, no text, no logo, no blood
scenes.motion: Static wide shot, then very slow push-in; waves crashing, boat pitching.
scenes.voiceover: Hải ơi! Tiếng gọi vang lên từ dưới nước đen.

scenes.label: Hai ra khoi xa
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, medium shot of a young Vietnamese fisherman in a white shirt holding the boat rail in a storm at night, his father at the wheel behind him, dark waves, cold blue light, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Slow tracking shot following Hai across the wet deck.
scenes.voiceover: Hải ra khơi xa, chuyến biển đêm đầu cùng cha.

scenes.label: Tay cha giu lai
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, close-up of a weathered Vietnamese fisherman's hands gripping a wooden ship wheel in a storm at night, calm determined face in the background, rain and sea spray, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Static close-up; slow focus pull from hands to face.
scenes.voiceover: Tay cha ghì lái, mắt dõi nhìn cơn biển động.

scenes.label: Ghe lang Ong
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, wide shot of a Vietnamese fishing village at dusk, a whale temple with warm lanterns on the shore, wooden boats in the harbour, teal dusk light, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Slow pan from the temple to the boats.
scenes.voiceover: Trước giờ nhổ neo, hai cha con ghé lăng Ông.

scenes.label: Cha thap nhang
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, medium shot of an older Vietnamese fisherman lighting incense at a whale temple shrine at dusk, warm lamp glow, incense smoke, whale bones on the altar, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Slow push-in on the incense smoke and the altar.
scenes.voiceover: Cha thắp nén nhang, khấn xin Cá Ông phù hộ.

scenes.label: Xuong ca Ong
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, close-up of a large old whale skeleton in a Vietnamese whale temple, warm oil lamp light, incense smoke drifting, dark reverent background, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Static close-up; lamp light moves slowly along the bones.
scenes.voiceover: Ngọc cốt Cá Ông, trăm năm lặng lẽ giữ biển.

scenes.label: Tieng goi giua bien dong
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, medium shot of a young Vietnamese fisherman on a stormy boat deck at night, turning his head to listen, dark waves crashing, cold blue light, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Tracking shot following Hai as he turns toward the sea.
scenes.voiceover: Giữa cơn sóng dữ, tiếng gọi tên Hải lại vang.

scenes.label: Bong trang duoi nuoc
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, close-up of dark churning sea water at night from a boat deck, a pale shape gliding just beneath the waves, no face, cold blue moonlight, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Slow tilt down to the water; the pale shape passes.
scenes.voiceover: Hải cúi nhìn mặt nước, bóng trắng lớn lướt qua.

scenes.label: Ca Ong noi len
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, wide shot of a giant whale surfacing beside a wooden fishing boat in a stormy night sea, water pouring off its grey-blue back, cold moonlight, awe and calm, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Static wide shot; the whale rises slowly, water streaming.
scenes.voiceover: Cá Ông nổi lên giữa sóng, dẫn ghe vượt bão đêm.

scenes.label: Cha con cui dau
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, medium shot of a father and son fishermen bowing toward the sea on a boat deck at night, a giant whale diving in the background, calm water, warm lantern glow, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Slow push-in on the two bowing figures.
scenes.voiceover: Hai cha con cúi đầu, thầm cảm ơn Cá Ông cứu.

scenes.label: Song lang, tay vung
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, close-up of a young Vietnamese fisherman's steady hands on a wooden ship wheel at dawn, calm sea behind, soft golden light, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Static close-up; the wheel steadies as the sea calms.
scenes.voiceover: Sóng dần lặng xuống, tay Hải vững vàng giữ lái.

scenes.label: Ghe ve lang chai
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic film still, wide shot of a Vietnamese fishing village harbour at sunrise, wooden boats returning, whale temple on the shore, golden dawn light, joyful and peaceful, film grain, no text
scenes.motion: Slow crane up revealing the sunrise over the harbour.
scenes.voiceover: Bình minh, ghe cập bến, cả làng chài reo vui.

cover_hook: Giữa biển động, có tiếng gọi tên Hải từ dưới nước…
description: Giữa đêm biển động miền Trung, có tiếng gọi tên Hải vọng lên từ dưới làn nước đen. Lần đầu ra khơi xa cùng cha, Hải chứng kiến huyền thoại Cá Ông dẫn ghe vượt sóng dữ trở về bình an. Phim ma dân gian Việt Nam (AIGC).
cta: Bạn đã từng nghe người làng chài kể chuyện Cá Ông cứu người chưa?
